ECB PRESIDENT LAGARDE TO STEP DOWN EARLY IN FEBRUARY 2027 European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde announced she will resign on February 7, 2027, eight months before her term expires. Her departure triggers a major leadership contest as the ECB confronts elevated inflation, rising bond yields and geopolitical uncertainty. Pablo Hernández de Cos of Spain and Klaas Knot of the Netherlands are leading contenders to replace her. Markets currently expect further ECB interest-rate hikes follo

ECB OFFICIALS EXPECT DECEMBER RATE HIKE, THEN PAUSE ECB policymakers expect a 25-basis-point rate hike on December 17, lifting the deposit rate from 2.50% to 2.75%, according to three sources cited by Reuters. The hike is considered nearly certain unless energy prices fall sharply. However, officials expect to pause further tightening afterward, as rising bond yields could reduce eurozone growth by 1 percentage point and inflation by 0.9 percentage points over 2027–2028.

US MORTGAGE RATES FALL FOR SECOND STRAIGHT WEEK The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate dropped to 7.24%, down from 7.32% last week and 7.40% two weeks ago, according to Freddie Mac. The decline follows a retreat in 10-year Treasury yields, partly driven by investors shifting from technology stocks into government bonds. However, mortgage rates remain more than one percentage point above year-ago levels, weighing on housing affordability and demand.
